stability_formula: 0.5 * zscore(current raw factor) + 0.5 * zscore(negative 9-quarter-spaced TTM volatility)
stability_timing_proxy: Three monthly signal intervals approximate one quarter.
common_treatment: MAD winsorization, CITIC 2019 first-level industry neutralization, log-market-cap neutralization, z-score.
ronoa_restriction: Stable RONOA is not eligible for the main composite because the underlying strict RONOA data coverage was insufficient.
